cs.t: If you split your own firewood by hand, a Fiskars splitting axe is insanely better than any standard splitting maul you'd find in a typical hardware store:  https://www.fiskars.com/en-us/gardening-and-yard-care/produc...  For mechanical pencils, the Rotring 600 is the best thing I've ever written with:  https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00AZWYUA4/
cs.th: Ask HN: What are the best-designed things you've ever used?
